item.title: Minister Admits Nicotine Vape Liquid Scheduled Poison After Court Ruling
item.description:
Source: CodeBlue (Malaysia Health)
Dr Dzul makes a major admission in Parliament, saying vape liquids containing nicotine are now subject to the Poisons Act 1952 (Act 366), due to the High Court verdict. Act 366 prohibits the retail sale and supply of poisons, except by pharmacists/doctors. The post Minister Admits Nicotine Vape Liquid Scheduled Poison After Court Ruling appeared first on CodeBlue .
